title: ZEDEC XERO VULPINE (ZXV): a post-quantum operating system and local multi-agent AI swarm
description:
ZXV is a freestanding, from-scratch C kernel with post-quantum security that also runs as a desktop app on macOS, Linux and Windows. It runs a swarm of small language models on an integer-only tensor engine that gives the same output bits on every CPU, under a tokens-per-cycle budget and a cooperative swarm economy. The same kernel builds as bare-metal UEFI discs for arm64 and x86_64.

This archive is the source code of the GitHub release. No model weights are included.
